CORE: settle the case where more than floor(v/3) lines have v2(M_tt) > gamma (cancellation lines, PR 2869's rename of PR 2717 residue class (i)/PR 2747's tied-minimum lines): either the named families (Lemma SG anchor, Lemma MX repairs, Lemma MP pivots, repair/ordering in the PR 2747 style) still certify floor(2v/3), or the true residual obstruction is isolated with a precise definition and settled on tied_min (12/12 cancellation lines) and cex_min_1 (11/19) plus a smallest-first falsifier search across decoders with 1..v cancellation lines. CORRECTIVE: PR 2869 found that PR 2717's dyadic-corollary sentence has a normalization gap as literally stated (dyadic entries do not imply the factorization is 2-integral); the corrected corollary is stated with the gamma/S_gamma formulation and a corrective comment is posted on PR 2717.

bottleneck_link: F-star is the named route to closing every open T = 3 window at once (research/root-unit-decoder-lemmas section 7, consequence PROVEN given F-star). Residue (i-prime) is the last named residue thread: when the anchor is short (more than floor(v/3) cancellation lines) only structure can carry the threshold, and the fixtures show cert can sit at v-1 there. Settling whether the named families always certify floor(2v/3), and isolating precisely what resists them, decides how a proof of F-star must proceed.
evidence: RESIDUE (I-PRIME) SETTLED ON BOTH CANONICAL FIXTURES AND PROBED ACROSS THE 1..v CANCELLATION-LINE AXIS; TRUE RESIDUAL OBSTRUCTION ISOLATED AND RECORDED; DYADIC-COROLLARY NORMALIZATION GAP REPRODUCED AND REPAIRED; F-STAR NOT PROVED AND NOT REFUTED. PROVEN (README.md, written proofs): Lemma CT (cancellation lines are exactly the even-tie lines tau(t) in {0,2}; tied totals lie in D(t); |D(t)| = 1 lines are pivot-bit-forced and never two-tie); Lemma CL3 (insertion-finite mixing: anchor lines insert at valid cuts of the pivot order iff the joint demand digraph is acyclic, extending Lemma MX's two block orders); the corrected dyadic corollary (cert(M) >= |S_gamma| = v - #{t : v2(M_tt) > gamma} for every rational decoder; Lemma AN's literal hypothesis holds exactly when c_j >= 0 for all totals; the global rescale 2^{-gamma} M restores it; the anchored set is S_gamma, not the odd-diagonal set). CHECKED (verify.py, stdlib, deterministic, about 67 s, certificate digest 7f27c1e761b34c98): controls 8/8 including the two normalization-gap exhibits (SC1: dyadic p = q = (1/2)(1,1) with content -2 and empty per-total rescaling interval, corrected anchor reach 2 of 2; SC2: M = 2 I_3, naive odd-diagonal count 0 vs corrected reach 3); calibration reproducing every recorded anchor (tied_min 11/12 with MP 9 over 4096 pivot maps; cex_min_1 18/19 with MP 16 over 6144 pivot maps; chain 22 on the stored pairing; PR 2869 reach = anchor_good 0/12 and 8/19; PR 2890 PASS_FC4_CALIBRATION values); fixture settlement through the named-family ladder (tied_min: 12/12 cancellation lines, MP certifies at 9 >= 8 with zero anchor reach; cex_min_1: 11/19 cancellation lines, MP certifies at 16 >= 12; Lemma CL3 insertion bounded scan of 2^20 configurations: best mixed value 16, up to 5 of 8 anchor lines placeable at the best config and 7 seen, adding nothing over pure pivots; family gap cert - named = 2 on both fixtures: 11 > 9, 18 > 16); the smallest-first search (153 records, v = 3..12, exact k = 1..v, 75 parity + 34 tied_min-signature structured + 44 adversary runs; named = cert = v on every generated record; min named ratio 1.000) and the GL_3(Z) re-split probe at fixture density (24 re-splits + 1 engine probe; min named ratio 0.895 = 17/19; engine adds 1 on the hardest; cancellation counts seen 11 and 12, limited by the invariant diagonal valuations); 0 falsifiers in 178 records; the falsifier criterion armed everywhere and never fired. DEMOTED / OPEN: F-star for general rational decoders is not proved here. The threshold obstruction named(M) < floor(2v/3) is not realized in the searched domain; the realized residual obstruction is the family gap named(M) < cert(M) (the attaining witnesses use labels outside the anchor/repair/pivot families), which a proof must close either via the matched-pivot floor (PR 2747 open question 1, witnessed on all 178 records and at 9/12 and 16/19 on the fixtures) or via a two-bit-label lemma (PR 2747 open question 3). The generator route cannot realize fixture-density zero digraphs (Lemma RK (c) forces |pi(t) intersect sigma(s)| >= 2 at every arc; random factorizations give sparse Z and easy pivot floors) - exact obstruction recorded, not an unrealizability claim. The CL3 evaluation on cex_min_1 is a bounded scan, not an exhaustive maximum.
